title: CRM Data Enrichment Agent Input
description: Configure the CRM data enrichment process: choose contact source, field mapping, limits, enrichment providers, crawling and scoring options.

contactsSource.title: Contact source
contactsSource.description: Where to load contacts from: JSON input, CSV text, or an Apify dataset ID.

contactsJson.title: Contacts (JSON)
contactsJson.description: Array of contact objects when source is 'json'. Each object should have at least an email; optional fields: firstName, lastName, company, phone.

contactsCsv.title: Contacts (CSV)
contactsCsv.description: CSV string with headers when source is 'csv'. First row must be header names; use the field mapping options to match column names.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: Apify dataset ID when source is 'dataset'. The Actor will read items from this dataset up to the maximum contacts limit.

emailField.title: Email field name
emailField.description: Property or column name for the contact's email in your data.

firstNameField.title: First name field
firstNameField.description: Property or column name for first name (optional).

lastNameField.title: Last name field
lastNameField.description: Property or column name for last name (optional).

companyField.title: Company field
companyField.description: Property or column name for company (optional).

maxContacts.title: Maximum contacts
maxContacts.description: Maximum number of contacts to process. Earlier contacts are processed first.

dedupeKeys.title: Deduplication keys
dedupeKeys.description: Keys used to identify duplicates. Allowed: email, domain, companyNameNormalized, firstName, lastName. Add one key per line or use the JSON editor.

enrichment.title: Enrichment settings
enrichment.description: Configure enrichment providers: website fallback (no API key), Clearbit, and Hunter.

enableWebsiteFallback.title: Enable website fallback
enableWebsiteFallback.description: Fetch company websites for light enrichment (no API key required).

enableClearbit.title: Enable Clearbit
enableClearbit.description: Use Clearbit API for enrichment. Requires Clearbit API key.

enableHunter.title: Enable Hunter
enableHunter.description: Use Hunter API for email finding. Requires Hunter API key.

crawling.title: Crawling settings
crawling.description: HTTP request settings: rate limit (global across website, Clearbit, and Hunter), timeout, retries, and concurrency.

maxRequestsPerMinute.title: Max requests per minute
maxRequestsPerMinute.description: Global rate limit for all enrichment requests (website, Clearbit, Hunter) combined.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Number of retries on failed requests.

useProxy.title: Use proxy (Tier 2)
useProxy.description: When website fetch is blocked (403/429), retry with Apify Proxy (residential/rotating).

usePlaywrightFallback.title: Use Playwright fallback (Tier 3)
usePlaywrightFallback.description: When proxy fails, try headless browser (Playwright). Requires Playwright optional dependency.

scoring.title: Scoring settings
scoring.description: Configure contact quality scoring. Weights should sum to about 1.0.

enabled.title: Enable scoring
enabled.description: Calculate quality scores for each contact.

emailValid.title: Email valid weight
emailValid.description: Weight for valid email in the score (0-1).

hasWebsite.title: Has website weight
hasWebsite.description: Weight for having website data in the score (0-1).

hasPhone.title: Has phone weight
hasPhone.description: Weight for having phone number in the score (0-1).

hasSocial.title: Has social weight
hasSocial.description: Weight for having social links in the score (0-1).

companySignals.title: Company signals weight
companySignals.description: Weight for company enrichment signals in the score (0-1).

weights.title: Legacy weights object
weights.description: Legacy input compatibility only. Use individual scoring fields above.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Send run summary/results to n8n, OpenClaw, or a generic webhook endpoint after processing completes.

enableWebhook.title: Enable generic webhook
enableWebhook.description: Send payload to a custom webhook URL.

webhookUrl.title: Generic webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint for generic webhook delivery.

webhookSecret.title: Webhook signing secret
webhookSecret.description: Optional HMAC SHA256 secret for X-Webhook-Signature header.

payloadMode.title: Payload mode
payloadMode.description: Choose whether webhook payload includes summary, full results, or both.

webhookMaxRetries.title: Webhook max retries
webhookMaxRetries.description: Retry attempts for failed webhook requests.

webhookRetryDelayMs.title: Webhook retry delay (ms)
webhookRetryDelayMs.description: Base delay between webhook retry attempts.

enableN8n.title: Enable n8n webhook
enableN8n.description: Send payload to an n8n webhook endpoint.

enableOpenClaw.title: Enable OpenClaw webhook
enableOpenClaw.description: Send payload to an OpenClaw webhook endpoint.

highScoreWebhookUrl.title: High-score route URL
highScoreWebhookUrl.description: Optional route: send high-score contacts to this webhook URL.

failedWebhookUrl.title: Failed route URL
failedWebhookUrl.description: Optional route: send failed contacts to this webhook URL.

intelligence.title: Intelligence & efficiency
intelligence.description: Advanced controls for adaptive enrichment, caching, AI fallback, learning memory, routing intelligence, and cost guardrails.

adaptiveEnrichment.title: Adaptive enrichment
adaptiveEnrichment.description: Skip paid providers when confidence is already high.

minConfidenceForApiEnrichment.title: Min confidence for paid APIs
minConfidenceForApiEnrichment.description: If confidence is >= this value, adaptive mode skips paid APIs.

cacheTtlHours.title: Cache TTL (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: How long cached domain enrichments stay valid.

aiFallbackMode.title: AI fallback mode
aiFallbackMode.description: Fallback when extraction is weak: off, local heuristic, or webhook.

aiFallbackWebhookUrl.title: AI fallback webhook URL
aiFallbackWebhookUrl.description: Used only when AI fallback mode is 'webhook'.

progressivePipeline.title: Progressive pipeline
progressivePipeline.description: Limit paid APIs to top confidence band of contacts.

maxApiEnrichmentPercent.title: Top contacts for paid APIs (%)
maxApiEnrichmentPercent.description: Only this percentage of contacts are eligible for paid APIs.

enableConfidenceExplainability.title: Enable confidence explainability
enableConfidenceExplainability.description: Attach confidence score, breakdown, and reasons per contact.

enableDomainLearning.title: Enable domain learning
enableDomainLearning.description: Persist domain allow/block learning across runs.

learningBlockThreshold.title: Learning block threshold
learningBlockThreshold.description: Mark domain as blocklisted after this many failures.

learningAllowThreshold.title: Learning allow threshold
learningAllowThreshold.description: Mark domain as allowlisted after this many successes.

smartRetry.title: Smart retry
smartRetry.description: Use exponential backoff + jitter for outbound integrations.

budgetGuardrails.title: Enable budget guardrails
budgetGuardrails.description: Cap paid provider calls per run.

maxExternalApiCalls.title: Max external API calls
maxExternalApiCalls.description: Hard cap for Clearbit + Hunter calls in a run.

output.title: Output settings
output.description: Configure how results are written to the dataset and key-value store.

pushPartialResultsEvery.title: Push results every N contacts
pushPartialResultsEvery.description: Stream results to the dataset in batches of this size.

saveDebugArtifacts.title: Save debug artifacts
saveDebugArtifacts.description: Store HTML snippets for debugging in the key-value store.
